brief: Screening note on Southeast Asian polypropylene and HDPE price trends through 2026.

sections.title: Polypropylene and HDPE Price Movement (2024-2026)
questions: What were the monthly price trends for polypropylene (PP) and high-density polyethylene (HDPE) in Southeast Asia from January 2024 through August 2026?
Were there any notable periods of price volatility, gaps, or missing data in the series?
How do the price trends for PP and HDPE compare over this period?
sections.tool_rationale: The price series provides the quantitative monthly price trends for PP and HDPE, while relevant documents may offer context or explanations for significant price movements or anomalies.
sections.unanswerable_if: If the price series for either PP or HDPE in Southeast Asia is missing or too incomplete to establish a trend.

sections.title: Operational Events Affecting Polypropylene and HDPE Markets (2025-2026)
questions: What major operational events (such as plant startups, shutdowns, expansions, or force majeures) occurred in Southeast Asia that could have influenced PP and HDPE prices during 2025-2026?
Are there documented links between these events and observed price movements?
sections.tool_rationale: Documents provide details on operational events and may discuss their impact on market prices, which cannot be inferred from price data alone.
sections.unanswerable_if: If there are no documents describing operational events relevant to PP or HDPE production in Southeast Asia during the period.

excluded.topic: Price forecast or outlook for PP and HDPE after August 2026
excluded.reason: The price series and documents only cover up to August 2026, and the corpus explicitly excludes forecasts or forward-looking commentary.
